summary: Sadot Group Inc. disclosed on Form 8-K that on September 30, 2026, it entered and closed an Asset Purchase Agreement with Softech Resources Limited (Hong Kong) to acquire the SalesIQ AI-enabled commercial origination platform, including source code, models, databases, domains and trademarks. Consideration is US$300,000 cash payable in twelve equal monthly installments of US$25,000 through August 2027 without interest, plus 3,575 shares of newly designated Series D Non-Voting Contingently Convertible Preferred Stock. The Company assumed only specified post-closing contract liabilities; the Seller retained all others. Watch post-closing integration risk with TradeIQ and TradeOS and potential dilution from Series D conversion.
